candidate_family.ray_hypothesis: For +u net cell count n>=0, PRE_u^(p)(n)=(n,-r_p(n),-r_p(n)) with r_p(n)=n^(1/p). Cyclic relabeling supplies v/w controls; negatives use exact algebraic sign inversion.
candidate_family.completion_candidates: If k^p<n<(k+1)^p, root magnitude may complete to k or k+1; neither branch is preferred before atlas propagation.
candidate_family.table_domain: n=0..36 for p=1..6, exact perfect-power / interval bookkeeping

mandatory_mixed_path_controls: C[1,1,1] reached by all six shortest permutations
model_scope: Candidates are explanations of the already constructed integer-cell atlas; they do not define cell identity.
